notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Greetings, players. I hope you are doing well.

We made an update to fix certain issues when characters are affected by status problems. Specifically, whenever a character is either asleep, frozen, or confused, their active time bar would continue running as usual. We have fixed this issue.

If you encounter any future issues, please report them on the Drillimation Bug Tracker on GitHub. Instructions for it are in a pinned thread.
